SELECT COUNT(*) AS loans, COUNT(a.account_id) AS matched_accounts,
       COUNT(d.district_id) AS matched_districts,
       MIN(l.date) AS earliest_approval, MAX(l.date) AS latest_approval,
       COUNT(DISTINCT l.duration) AS term_lengths, MIN(l.duration) AS shortest_term,
       MAX(l.duration) AS longest_term, COUNT(date(l.date)) AS parsed_dates
FROM main.loan AS l
LEFT JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
LEFT JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id;

WITH region_totals AS (
    SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_approved_amount
    FROM main.loan AS l
    JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE '1995-12-31' BETWEEN l.date AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months')
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT region, total_approved_amount
FROM region_totals
WHERE total_approved_amount = (SELECT MAX(total_approved_amount) FROM region_totals)
ORDER BY region
LIMIT -1
